name: fauxplane
description: Tooling for the fauxplane jet panel PWA. The deployed app is public/ and has no build step; scripts/ regenerates the navdata the app precaches.
//dependencies: Deliberately none. build-navdata.mjs uses only node: builtins (crypto, fs, path, url, util) and global fetch, so there is no lockfile to pin and nothing third-party executes on a runner (Doctrine §16.1/§16.3). If that stops being true, add package-lock.json and switch automation to npm ci in the same commit.
